title.hr: Od blokovnog uređaja do točke montiranja

concept.hr: Disk → particija → datotečni sustav → montiranje; montiranje zaklanja sadržaj
concept.en: Disk → partition → filesystem → mount; a mount hides what was there

summary.hr: Tri koraka od praznog diska do staze, pa montiranje preko direktorija s datotekom: nije obrisana, df je i dalje broji, a staza do nje ne vodi.
summary.en: Three steps from an empty disk to a path, then a mount over a directory holding a file: not deleted, df still counts it, but the path no longer leads to it.

concept.hr: Tablica particija i particija, mkfs, mount: tek tada df ima redak
concept.en: Partition table and partition, mkfs, mount: only then does df have a row

concept.hr: Staza vodi u najnovije; umount skida gornje
concept.en: The path leads to the newest; umount removes the top one
